subject.title: feat(repair): define durable cluster intake intents

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt the proposed five-PR durable cluster-intake architecture as the repair lane’s supported persistence and dispatch path?
rationale: This PR introduces a new internal durability contract whose value and operational semantics depend on four companion PRs; accepting that architecture is a maintainer product and operations decision, not a mechanical branch repair.

options.title: Sponsor the durable stack
options.body: Review the five layers as one ordered design and merge them only after the integrated recovery and production-gate behavior is accepted.

options.title: Narrow the design
options.body: Keep this PR open while maintainers identify a smaller durable-intake contract or existing state mechanism that should be reused instead.

options.title: Pause the architecture
options.body: Leave the current repair path unchanged and close or replace the stack if durable cluster dispatch is not a near-term priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable stack
recommendation.body: Review the five layers as one ordered design and merge them only after the integrated recovery and production-gate behavior is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible recent contributor across each linked layer and are best positioned to explain the intended contract and sequencing.
